title: Book an appointment
summary: Create an appointment from the Create button: patient, service, doctor, room, date and time.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: From here you create appointments, reminders and notes.

steps.title: Choose the patient
steps.details: Search by name, phone or ID. If the patient has a default doctor, it's suggested automatically.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: Optional. Sets the appointment's duration and what will be billed.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: Who sees the patient. Only the times when they're available are offered.

steps.title: Room
steps.details: The calendar (room or chair) where the spot is booked.

steps.title: Time
steps.details: Start time; the end is calculated from the service's duration.

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: Optional. Internal text shown on the appointment.

steps.title: Save the appointment
steps.details: Review the details and save. The patient is notified if they have reminders turned on.
